title: feat(plugin-detail): a click on a record field value edits that field alone and saves it in place
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XS45uS4YmpkyKDUwCT41Tq)_
Fixes #36475
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 记录页（整页、右侧预览、手机、宽屏左栏）的字段区：点一个字段的值，只有这个字段变成输入框，回车或点别处就保存；以前是整条记录变成表单、要点底部「保存」。
- 记录页专题的一张子单，按你同意的协调席建议做：和列表格内编辑一致，改一个字段不用进整页表单。
- 保存失败时这个字段留在编辑状态、输入不丢、原因写在字段下面；不对可以直接撤回这个改动，页头「编辑」的整页表单没动。
- 无。

## What changes

On the default record page's field list (full page, side preview, phone, the wide page's pinned column), a click on an editable value now edits that value alone, per the maintainer's 「同意」 recorded in the card body. That lifts ruling 7066516044's "unchanged: one save bar" for the click-a-value path only; the header Edit path is untouched.

- `DetailSection` (field face only): a click on an editable value, or its keyboard pencil, opens `FieldInPlaceEditor` over that value instead of entering the whole-record session. Other fields stay values, no save bar is drawn, the page does not move (the editor is a layer over the value). Offered only where the record context can write the record the page shows; elsewhere the old whole-record entry stands. A whole-record session (header Edit) closes any open in-place editor.
- `FieldInPlaceEditor` (new): the editor is the list cell's — `FieldEditWidget` with `inCell` and `onCommit` — so typed values are an input, single select / date / record / person open their panel at once and save on the pick, multi-select saves when you move on. Enter or a click elsewhere saves; multi-line text saves on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter (Enter is a new line); Esc discards and writes nothing; an unchanged value writes nothing; a check flips and saves on the click. Types the cell editor does not take fall back to the record page's own `InlineFieldInput`.
- The write is `InlineEditSaveBar`'s, in a session of the field's own: new `face="field"` (no bar, no window shortcuts, its dialogs only) and `saveRef` (its save, called with the draft). So it is the same guarded `update` with `ifMatch`, the server's refusal attributed to the field and shown under it with the editor left open, the 409 reload/overwrite dialog, and the required-fields fill-in dialog. After a save the record context's `reread` runs, so every visible / read-only / required condition depending on the field is judged on the new record.
- Esc inside the editor is the editor's: its layer is the top Radix layer, so the side preview's sheet never sees the key (aligned with #36472, whose own fix is not absorbed here).

Why not the grid's layer: `CellOverlay` (components) anchors to a `td` / `gridcell`, carries the grid's frozen-column and scroll-hide rules, and is not exported; the per-type editors inside it (`FieldEditWidget` `inCell` faces) are what is shared, and are reused as is. No file under `ui/packages/fields/src/**` changed.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/FieldInPlaceEditor.tsx` — the commit rules (`commit`, the layer's `onInteractOutside` / `onEscapeKeyDown` / `onKeyDown`) and the toggle path.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` — `handleSave` now takes an optional handed draft; the Save button calls it with none (it used to receive the click event as its argument position, unused before).
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` — `editsInPlace` / `enterEdit` and the writer read from the record context.

## Tests

<details><summary>New: FieldInPlaceEditor-36475.test.tsx (13 cases)</summary>

Only the clicked field becomes an editor, no save bar, other values unchanged · a click elsewhere saves: one `update` carrying only that field with `ifMatch`, then `reread` · Enter saves a one-line value · Esc discards with no write · unchanged value writes nothing · multi-line: Enter no write, Ctrl+Enter saves · single select opens its options at once and a pick saves · a date opens its calendar at once and a pick saves · a check flips and saves with no editor drawn · a refused save (VALIDATION_FAILED on a cleared required field) stays open, keeps the empty input, shows the reason under the field as `role=alert`, no reread, no bar · control: header Edit still turns every field into an input under one save bar · control: with no record context to write to the click enters the whole-record session as before · Esc in an editor inside a Radix dialog cancels the edit and the dialog's `onOpenChange` is never called.

</details>

<details><summary>Rewritten pins (behaviour changed by the ruling, not loosened)</summary>

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx`, describe `RecordDetailView.recordEditState-35599`:

- "ruling B (「全部保留」): … keeps inline edit, which saves the record alone through the save bar" → "… keeps editing a field in place, which saves the record alone": the pencil now opens the in-place editor, Enter writes `{ summary }` through the plain `update` (still no batch), and no save bar is drawn; the edit-state half is unchanged.
- "one mode at a time: Edit with unsaved inline changes asks first …" → "a field edited in place is saved when Edit is pressed, and the edit state opens without asking": on the field list there is no longer an unsaved shared draft to ask about — the press on Edit lands outside the editor and saves the field first.
- "CONTROL — an inline session with no changes is simply ended …" → "CONTROL — a field opened in place with no change writes nothing: Edit enters the edit state without asking".
- Removed the now-unused `detailInputValues` helper.

Unchanged and still green: `DetailSection.fieldList-36147.test.tsx` (#36147 / #36292 "a click enters edit" pins). They render `DetailSection` with no record context, so they now pin the no-writer path, which keeps calling `onEnterInlineEdit`; the in-place path is pinned by the new file.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Cleared required field ⇒ one refused write.** The card asks that a cleared required field clicked away from stays in edit with the reason and is not saved: it does. The dispatch's "无写" (no request) is not met: on this surface the server is the validation authority by the objectui#6868 ruling written atop `InlineEditSaveBar` (⛔ no client-side rule evaluator, ⛔ no shared evaluator extracted), so the save is sent and refused, and nothing is stored. The list cell (#36023) judges client-side with plugin-grid's `cellValueRefusal`, which plugin-detail cannot import. This is a deviation from #36023's behaviour, kept on purpose.
- **Select options are not narrowed by a state machine** here, as the grid's editor does with plugin-grid's `stateMachineNextValues`; a disallowed move is refused by the server and shown under the field.
- A field whose save was refused stays open; a click on another field opens that one too, so two editors can be open after a refusal.
- `RecordEditStateController`'s discard-ask ("Edit with unsaved inline changes asks first") is no longer reachable from the default page's field list (no shared draft there now); it is still reachable on an authored page (double-click), and its only pin was the harness case rewritten above.
- Screenshots before / after: NOT MEASURED — booting the showcase backend and Console needs a full workspace build under the shared verify lock; the CI `Live E2E UI` and a maintainer click on the record page are the visual check.

## Verification

Two minutes: open any record of a custom object on its default page, click a text value — only it becomes an input, no bar at the bottom; type, click elsewhere — one `PATCH`/update in the network tab carrying that one field; click a select value — its options open, a pick saves; press the header Edit — the whole form with Save / Cancel, as before.
